svg.title: SAP MM - Horizontal Procure-to-Pay Flow
svg.desc: Native editable SVG for an independent SAP MM portfolio. Based on the UCI Online Retail dataset and simulated purchasing transactions. No raster images or bitmap traces.

g.text: A simulated procurement lifecycle from inventory planning to invoice verification and exception management.
Alpha costs £17.30 more but arrives on time.
PO 14 EA · GR 12 EA · Invoice 14 EA
Invoice Qty ≤ PO and GR Qty; PO Price = Invoice Price
Data source: UCI Online Retail (StockCode, Description)
Procurement, pricing, supplier and inventory data: simulated
Excel-based functional simulation; no SAP posting performed
Issue: ISS-MM-001 · OPEN_REVIEW · No payment recorded
